summary: No-code relational database platform — enterprise workflows are sticky, but AI databases with Postgres backends are rising.
moat: Airtable's moat is its no-code relational data model embedded in 300,000+ organizations, connecting marketing calendars, product roadmaps, and inventory pipelines with automated triggers. Its Interface Designer allows non-technical operators to build internal software without code. The emerging challenger wave builds on open-source Postgres and Supabase, using AI to generate schemas and views with zero proprietary lock-in.

challengers.name: NocoDB, Baserow, and AI Postgres builders
challengers.evidence: Open-source Airtable alternatives like NocoDB and Baserow have crossed 50,000 GitHub stars combined, offering self-hosted relational databases with native AI query generation.
